title: RNN Basics — Unroll the Reused Rule
key_insight: Unrolling draws the reused cell once per time step. Backpropagation through time sends correction backward through those linked uses.
body:
## Unroll the Reused Rule

One RNN cell appears in the code, but a ten-word sentence creates ten linked calculations.

Unrolling draws the reused cell once per time step. Backpropagation through time sends correction backward through those linked uses.

Sequences in a batch may have different lengths. Padding makes a common shape, while masks stop padded positions from affecting loss or state.
common_mistakes: An RNN treats every sequence position as unrelated.
Hidden state is always a human-readable sentence.
Padding should contribute to the training loss as real data.
mini_exercise: Sketch the situation in “Unroll the Reused Rule” as three labeled steps, then explain what changes at each step.
real_world_usage: RNNs introduce sequence state and make the limitations that motivated transformers concrete.
explain_back_prompt: Using the “Unroll the Reused Rule” situation, explain RNN Basics without assuming the listener knows deep learning.
